name: SDN-AP Propagator
description: General-perturbations propagation of whole catalogs in one WASM module. Theories: SGP4 (STR#3 / Vallado 2006), SGP4XP (the US Space Force SGP4-XP theory, clean-room from the public change list and the black-box specification) and SDN-AP (SDN's own theory). Propagator ABI exports (plugin_init_omm, plugin_propagate, plugin_propagate_batch, plugin_entity_count, plugin_destroy; Earth-fixed meters) and a structure-of-arrays batch entry (sdnap_*; TEME or Earth-fixed). Bounded memory per object, fixed at ingest; any time costs at most one checkpoint interval of integration, and results do not depend on the order times are requested in.

methods.description: Adopts mean elements from SDS $OMM records (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4 or SGP4XP; for SGP4XP, BTERM in BSTAR and AGOM in MEAN_MOTION_DDOT, both m^2/kg) and replaces the module's element set. Propagation is reached through the propagator ABI exports and the sdnap_* batch entry, not through this invoke surface.

methods.displayName: Fit OEM to SGP4XP or SDN-AP elements
methods.description: Fits an element set to each $OEM ephemeris block; the configuration's THEORY selects the theory. UNSPECIFIED or SGP4XP: the six mean elements, BTERM and AGOM of an SGP4XP set (Levenberg-Marquardt on TEME position residuals with analytic Jacobians for the elements and BTERM and a theory difference for AGOM, weak priors on BTERM and AGOM about zero), rounded to the two-line text's digits and searched on their lattice. SDNAP: an SDN-AP set (theory 16): the six mean elements, the signed effective ballistic coefficient B_eff = (1 - kappa) B (free), AGOM and the once-per-revolution transverse terms tauc and taus (DESIGN 2b, 2c), B_eff and tau0 only in the drag regime (perigee below MEAN_ELEMENT.DRAG_REGIME_PERIGEE_KM, 2500 km); the density NRLMSISE-00 times exp(s(t)) under the environment of this invocation ($SPW rows on 'space_weather', a $PRW on 'space_weather_table', an open-DCA $DCL on 'density_correction'); a 'prior' $OMM with USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_B and _B_SIGMA gives kappa (2b.2), one with a previous set's USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_B_EFF and _B_EFF_SIGMA the B_eff prior (sigma floored at 10 % of the value); full precision. Either theory: the arc grown from two revolutions by threes to the fit interval; the interval ends at the block's USEABLE_STOP_TIME or FIT.HOLDOUT_HOURS before the data (later states held out and scored) and starts at USEABLE_START_TIME; without it the span rule (DESIGN 2e.3, $PCF FIT): FIT.DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS (48 h; ECCENTRIC_DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS 24 h above ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD 0.5), each candidate span fitted to the data before the latest TAIL_HOURS and scored on that tail, a longer one kept only when its tail error is within EXTENSION_MARGIN (0.9; eccentric 0.7) of the best shorter one's; a fit RMS beyond FIT.IMPLAUSIBLE_RMS_KM (100 km) is refused (fit-implausible). The $OMM carries MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4XP or SDNAP, ORIGINATOR (the $OEM's), the block OBJECT's NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID and OBJECT_NAME, the fit and held-out statistics in its COMMENT, and (SDNAP) USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_B_EFF, _B_EFF_SIGMA, _KAPPA, _KAPPA_SIGMA, _TAU0, _TAUC, _TAUS (m/s^2), _ARC_END_MIN, _LOWERING and _TAU_HELD; a $OBD per block carries the determination. The block's frame is read from its REFERENCE_FRAME, never assumed: TEME, GCRF or ICRF, EME2000 or J2000 and Earth-fixed (ITRF, ECEF, WGS84), time system UTC; Moon-, Sun- and segment blocks go to the SDN-AP segment fits (THEORY SDNAP). Plain or size-prefixed $OEM. Refused by name: configuration-missing, invalid-configuration, configuration-refused, missing-oem, invalid-oem, invalid-prior, reference-frame-undeclared, reference-frame-conflict, unsupported-frame, unsupported-time-system, too-few-states, fit-failed, fit-implausible.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.1: an Earth SGP4XP or SDN-AP $OMM across the burns of its $MNV records, in time order. Each record gives EVENT_START_TIME, the duration (EVENT_END_TIME, or TOTAL_BURN_TIME in s; none: an impulse) and DELTA_VEL_U/V/W (km/s, UVW of the pre-maneuver state: U radial, W along r x v, V = W x U). The post-maneuver set is the inverse of the output map at the burn's centroid, h^-1(x(t_b) + (0, dv), t_b), by fixed-point iteration in equinoctial elements (14); a finite burn scales the eccentricity-vector and plane changes by sinc(dL/2), dL = n D (15). Outputs: the post-maneuver $OMM of every burn (epoch the centroid; drag, SRP and SDN-AP parameters carried), its $MNV with PRE_EVENT and POST_EVENT states (TEME, osculating elements, BALLISTIC_COEFF = 1/B_eff kg/m^2) and the CHARACTERIZATION from the dv direction, and with a 'grid' the TEME states across the burns.

methods.displayName: Detect maneuvers in an Earth ephemeris
methods.description: DESIGN 5.1.4: the six-element generalized likelihood ratio on the innovations of SDN-AP's own inverse map, e_k = h^-1(x_k, t_k) - y(t_k), against a burn's signature (a step in a_f, a_g, chi, psi and n, a ramp in lambda; G = dy/dv by the inverse map at the candidate epoch), F = sum M^T W M, g = sum M^T W e, Delta v = F^-1 g, Lambda = g^T F^-1 g (16), W the MAD inverse variances. One TEME $OEM block per call, UTC, at least 48 states. Without a burn (largest Lambda at or below the threshold, 20 by default): the burn-free SDN-AP set. With one: the pre-burn set fitted on the states before the burn, the post-burn set carried by the impulse map of the estimated Delta v, and a $MNV (STATUS DETECTED, EVENT_START_TIME, DELTA_VEL_U/V/W, PRE_EVENT, POST_EVENT, ALGORITHM with Lambda).

inputPorts.description: One Earth TEME $OEM block.

$PCF 1.0.2 (SDS 1.268.0): THEORY and MANEUVER_DETECTION (THRESHOLD, MARGIN_STATES, REFINE_WINDOW_HOURS, MINIMUM_STATES, CORRELATION_MODEL WHITE or ONE_SAMPLE_PER_REVOLUTION, FALSE_ALARMS_PER_OBJECT_YEAR 1), MEAN_ELEMENT and INTEGRATOR (refused); THEORY UNSPECIFIED or SDNAP; fields left unset take the documented defaults, a set field this module cannot apply is refused by name (configuration-refused), the other tables are other methods'.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.2: each Earth SGP4XP or SDN-AP $OMM walked along its mean trajectory ($PCF REENTRY: nodes every NODE_STEP_MINUTES, 30, within HORIZON_DAYS, 120) until an averaging limit trips (18): C1 4 pi |a-dot| / (n H(h_p)) > HANDOFF_DECAY_RATIO (0.05), C2 perigee below HANDOFF_PERIGEE_ALTITUDE_KM (180 km), C3 |Delta(ae)_rev| / (ae) > HANDOFF_ECCENTRICITY_COLLAPSE (0.01) with e > HANDOFF_MINIMUM_ECCENTRICITY (0.01), C4 the perigee-pass sawtooth (3 pi / 8) |Delta a_rev| > 0.5 km with e > 0.02; then, one way, osculating integration in the module (EGM96 20 x 20, Sun and Moon, NRLMSISE-00 x exp(s(t)) with the set's B_eff and the environment of this invocation, radial SRP) down to ALTITUDE_KM (80 km) in OSCULATING_STEP_SECONDS (10 s) steps, within the horizon. One $RDM per set: REENTRY_EPOCH, REENTRY_LATITUDE/LONGITUDE, the window (20) with sigma_B/B from WINDOW_BALLISTIC_SIGMA when set, else the set's USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_B_EFF_SIGMA, else 5 %, density WINDOW_DENSITY_SIGMA (15 %) with WINDOW_CORRELATION_DAYS (2) (REENTRY_EPOCH_UNC hours, REENTRY_WINDOW_START/END, ORBIT_LIFETIME and its window in days, 68.27 %), INITIAL_STATE the hand-off state (TEME), BALLISTIC_COEFF = 1 / B_eff kg/m^2, the models named.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.3.1: the first Earth SDN-AP set of each SDS $LAM's INSERTION orbit or $BOV burnout vector (osculating a, e, i, Omega, omega and the argument of latitude u at EPOCH in REF_FRAME TEME, GCRF / ICRF or EME2000 / J2000): y0 = h^-1(x_ins, t_ins) by the inverse map; B_eff and AGOM from a 'prior' $OMM's USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_B_EFF and _AGOM, else 0.01 m^2/kg each; the $LAM sigmas give sigma_a, sigma_e, sigma_lambda and sigma_RAAN (21) in the COMMENT. A $BOV's EFG state is rotated to TEME by GMST. One of 'launch' and 'burnout' is required. An early $OEM goes to fit_sdnap.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.3.3: a batch released from one parent state x0 at t0 ($LAM INSERTION or $BOV), each object the impulse map of the parent set with its own separation Delta v_k (UVW at t0) and B_k. The batch-joint fit estimates the parent's six elements and the batch mean B, and per object Delta v_k and B_k, with B_k ~ N(B_mean, sigma_B^2) (sigma_B half the prior B_eff, Stein shrinkage) and Delta v_k ~ N(0, (1 m/s)^2); the arrowhead normal matrix is solved by the Schur complement in O(N). The objects' along-track order at the latest state (22) associates them with 'catalog' sets (both sorted, matched in order).
